name: Xiamen Tungsten Co.,Ltd.
summary: Xiamen Tungsten Co.,Ltd. engages in the sale of tungsten, molybdenum, rare earth, battery materials, and other industrial products in China. The company offers tungsten concentrate, carbide powder, oxide, powder, and APT, as well as cobalt powder; rare earth oxide, metal, permanent magnet, and phosphor; Molybdenum oxide, plate, electrodes, crucible, and round blank; and hydrogen storage alloy powder, lithium manganese oxide, ternary cathode material, lithium cobalt oxide, and lithium iron phosphate.
